{{Virgo}}
Virgo 19 is the 271st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 19th day of Virgo, and it is a Friday. It corresponds to ISO week 39, weekday 5.

Its informal Japanese name is 10宮19日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 271|Chapter 271]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152290}}.
